title: Abstention-to-resolution routing on GREG's mission path
problem: Cortex and compile abstentions reach the founder as a generic NO_STRATEGY ask with no actionable content. Attaching the missing organ does not unblock the mission, and the typed deficit from #167 is consumed by nothing.
baseline: B0 = 55e6d74 (#184 head) and P = 610c343 (#194 with #184 merged): every perturbation ends in NO_STRATEGY and nothing closes (v1 labelling and arms).

alternatives.name: Parser founder (S)
alternatives.description: A capable founder reads raw receipts and composes the attach or successor by hand on today's code.
disadvantages: An attach does not unblock the waiting mission
alternatives.revival_evidence: S matches or beats NEW on E2 in v2

alternatives.name: Producer only
alternatives.description: Typed resolution on receipts, with no engine consumer.
disadvantages: Nothing acts on it; this is #167's state

alternatives.name: Auto-apply resolutions
alternatives.description: GREG applies attaches and successors itself.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Abstentions keep producing generic asks; missions stay blocked even after the right attach.

roles.position: Serves #190's measured-dividend requirement and the 'nothing is disconnected' directive: a produced deficit is now consumed on GREG's one mission path.
material_concerns: The dividend must be a measured effect, not a resemblance
Metaphor-free: no new organ or framework, one module and one engine hook

roles.position: There is one producer (a receipt field bound by the digest) and one consumer (an engine hook). The hook reuses existing ask kinds, command kinds and blockers; it adds no ledger type and no second authority path.
material_concerns: Coupling between the cortex route policy and PART_OF; a drift test guards it
Compile-side detaches must stay with Genesis

roles.position: The author wrote the operators, the harness and the code, and the instrument defects were found by the same author. The guards against that are the frozen v1 result kept as-is, a v2 with NEW unchanged and disjoint base items, and the ablations. No independent reviewer has run yet.
material_concerns: A prepared command might widen authority

roles.position: The addition is small: 164 lines of producer and about 120 lines of engine. Ten mutants are all caught, and the seed replay passes 120/120. Rollback is a revert of 1d6b1c1.
material_concerns: The engine hook runs on every DONE cognition receipt; its cost is one dict read

roles.position: A protection question becomes a HUMAN_JUDGMENT wait and never closes. B0 achieved 30/30 UNANSWERED missions with an unanswered part (a baseline harm); the prerequisites remove that, and NEW must not reintroduce it.
material_concerns: H1 harm must be zero under the pre-registered text
A founder-detached capability must never be silently re-attached

evidence.claim: One prepared attach closes a detach-blocked mission
evidence.finding: ACHIEVED after one signed CAPABILITY_ATTACH; without the consumer, not achieved
44 closed of 203 rows; 29 errors (D1); 19 harm under the frozen D2 rule

counterevidence.claim: v1's verdict will likely be FAILED_HARM under the frozen instrument
counterevidence.finding: D2 scores formal-part attach closures as harm while the second engine stays detached; kept and reported

counterevidence.claim: No independent reviewer has replicated any result
counterevidence.finding: All runs are by the author

pass_1.intended_outcome: One founder signature closes the missions a typed abstention can name, with zero harmful closures and Genesis unchanged for FORM.

advantages.statement: It consumes #167's typed deficit on the canonical path
advantages.amplified_value: Every future cortex organ inherits actionable abstentions for free

advantages.statement: It reduces what the founder must author to the values only the founder holds
advantages.amplified_value: It compounds as missions repeat: the burden per closure falls toward one signature

disadvantages.statement: A prepared successor could carry a widened scope
disadvantages.redesigned_response: The successor is a deepcopy of the signed spec with only the request changed; a test asserts light_cone, closure and capabilities are identical

disadvantages.statement: Re-proposing a capability the founder just detached overrides the founder's decision
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Compile detaches stay with Genesis, which never re-proposes them. The cortex ATTACH asks only when that organ is the sole route, as the existing _cognition_ask does.

disadvantages.statement: The author measures their own work
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Pre-registration, a frozen v1 kept with its result, a v2 with NEW unchanged and disjoint items, and ablations

comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Parser founder S on P: measured in v1 and v2
comparisons.reversible_experiment: The pre-registered held-out runs v1 and v2 with ablations

rejected_alternatives.name: Auto-apply resolutions
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: A capability would authorize its own attachment

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked the design as deployed: the instrument, the authority surface and the blocker semantics.

new_weaknesses.statement: The suite's operators are builder-known, so NEW may fit them
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: v2 draws new base items with a new seed; the adversarial partition is still owed and is reported as a gap

new_weaknesses.statement: PART_OF can drift from the cortex route policy
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: A test asserts PART_OF equals the bridged solver organs; a mutation check covers it

new_weaknesses.statement: A forged receipt could claim a verified resolution
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The CognitiveReceipt field rejects verified!=false or foreign authority after the digest re-binds; a mutant proves it

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Test plus mutant: a successor that fills the founder's value itself is caught
The Genesis test caught the conflict and the compile path now defers
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any change to Genesis attach doctrine

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No independent reviewer is available in-session; disclosed
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Independent review on the draft PR

pass_2.final_design: Producer field on the receipt, plus an engine hook that asks once with an unsigned prepared command and blocks on the matching existing blocker. FORM falls through to Genesis, and compile detaches stay with Genesis.

residual_risks.risk: The dividend may not clear E1/E2 even in v2
residual_risks.mitigation: Report NO_DIVIDEND or PREREQUISITE_PORT_PLUS_INTEGRATION as measured; no re-tuning

residual_risks.risk: A HUMAN_HANDOFF block could leave missions waiting indefinitely
residual_risks.mitigation: The founder can answer, abandon or revise; listed as an open question

dissent.handling: Recorded; merge waits on the founder and the v2 result.

entries.position: Do not claim a dividend from author-run measurements alone
entries.rationale: Builder-known operators and instrument defects found by the builder
entries.evidence_threshold: The v2 verdict plus one independent replication of NEW vs B0 on v2's suite

migration_plan: Additive: receipts without a resolution stay valid, and answered receipts keep their identity. The draft PR is stacked on #194; nothing is migrated. This record decides only the experiment, a draft PR that is consequence-inert. Merging is a separate decision that requires Alfonso's approval and is not taken here.

steps: git revert 1d6b1c1 (and d9fea85 for the tests and gate)
Retained receipts with a resolution remain valid history and are simply no longer consumed

kill_criteria: Any H1 harmful closure in v2 under the pre-registered text
Any prepared command that widens scope
review_trigger: The v2 analysis lands, or the founder reviews the draft PR
